actions.text: The Command Post builds itself. You are the guns.
Select your Muster Post and train a squad — command points are your only budget.
Three enemy holds up the valley. Put all three Command Posts down to win.
The south hold is down. Its waves have stopped — take the ground.
The east hold is down. Its waves have stopped — take the ground.
The north hold is down. Its waves have stopped — take the ground.
Every hold is down. The valley is yours.
The Command Post is gone. Nothing left to support.
